mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months reduces discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs signals a labor market recovery, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
